levels.description:
Destroys itself along with the Operator when equipped; automatically chooses a Teammate with the most members in the corresponding Alliance, and <@ba.vup>dispatches</> a same-quality copy of that Operator to the Teammate during the next Rest Phase
<@ba.acrem>If no eligible Teammate exists, the original Operator will be returned</>
<@ba.acrem>Cannot be equipped by Custom Operators</>
